# FAO EcoCrop database (full export)

- **What:** Climate and soil requirement envelopes for 2,568 plant records (temperature, rainfall, pH, altitude, growth cycle, texture, depth, fertility, salinity, drainage, latitude, light, climate zones).
- **Original publisher:** FAO (EcoCrop). The FAO EcoCrop web service is not reachable from every network, so this file is a copy of the full export held in a public GitHub repository.
- **Retrieved from:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenCLIM/ecocrop/main/EcoCrop_DB.csv
- **Retrieved:** 2026-10-27 · **Rows:** 2,568 · **Encoding:** latin-1
- **Licence / use:** FAO data, used here with attribution to FAO EcoCrop. The GitHub repository has no licence file, so confirm FAO's current terms of use before any commercial redistribution. Keep this attribution in the app's data-sources page and PDF report.
- **Known limits:** Values are expert opinion, not measured yields. Envelopes are annual rainfall and mean temperature, not daily weather. About 20% of rows lack a full temperature/rain/pH envelope.
